schema_version.description: Lineage contract version. Optional additive fields are compatible within major version 1.

statement_id.description: Script-position identity shared with the v2 task contract; the designated join key between v1 and v2 artifacts of the same script. Absent when parsing started from a caller-supplied tree.

statement_index.description: Zero-based position among ALL statements of the script (matches v2 statement_sequence[].statement_index).

stmt_kind.description: 写表语句类型。不含独立 UPDATE/DELETE:本工具建模的是「从 SELECT 写入一张表」的字段血缘,行级写操作没有这样的投影 (CONTRACT-001)。MERGE 内的 UPDATE/DELETE 分支仍按 MERGE 语义处理。

is_cached_relation.description: 仅在为 true 时出现。该 CTAS 实际是 Spark 的 CACHE [LAZY] TABLE ... AS SELECT:关系同样由 SELECT 定义,但只存活于会话,消费者不应据此登记仓库中新增了一张表。

is_session_scoped_relation.description: 仅在为 true 时出现。该语句产出的关系只存活于会话,不会落到存储:TEMP VIEW / GLOBAL TEMP VIEW / CACHE [LAZY] TABLE 都属此列。消费者不应据此登记仓库中新增了一张表,统计表级覆盖时也应先排除。判据取自 AST 事实而非命名模式;不带 TEMPORARY 的 CREATE VIEW 会注册进 catalog 并跨会话存活,因此**不**带此标记。`is_cached_relation` 是本字段在 CACHE 语法上的既有子集,保持原义不变。

skipped_statements.description: Top-level statements that contract 1.0 does not model as projection writes.

target_table.description: Only on category=additional_write_statement: the write target this document did not model.

target_field_binding.description: Only emitted when optional target DDL/Schema metadata mode was requested. Records whether authoritative target-column binding was applied or SQL projection names were retained.

ambiguities.description: Unresolved choice sites. Candidate traces are possible sources and must not be merged into proven physical_sources.

window_context_sources.description: Optional. The columns a window grouped or ordered by, and which role each played. Every one of them also appears in the value/physical sources, which stay the complete dependency set; this array only says which of them the window used as context rather than computed. Omitted when there is none.

merge_branch.description: MERGE 写入所属的 WHEN 分支。Spark 有三种 WHEN 子句，本枚举只命名其中两种；第三种（NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE）**不发本字段**，改由 merge_branch_qualifier 承载——与其发一个会让消费者算出错误行集语义的名字，不如不发。

merge_branch_qualifier.description: 本枚举无法命名的 WHEN 子句种类。出现即表示 merge_branch 缺席是因为契约词汇不足，而不是因为这不是一条 MERGE 写入（语句种类见顶层 stmt_kind）。两种被枚举命名的分支上不出现，因此既有产物形状不变。

output_ordinal.description: Zero-based SQL output occurrence; remains distinct when MERGE clauses write the same field.

merge_branch.description: MERGE 写入所属的 WHEN 分支。Spark 有三种 WHEN 子句，本枚举只命名其中两种；第三种（NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE）**不发本字段**，改由 merge_branch_qualifier 承载——与其发一个会让消费者算出错误行集语义的名字，不如不发。

qualifier.description: SQL qualifier that selected this source field.

binding_scope_id.description: Scope where the qualifier's input occurrence is declared.

input_ref_id.description: Exact input_source_refs identity for this field reference.

candidates.description: Only on AMBIGUOUS refs: every source that could have supplied this column. Consumers must not collapse it to one (LINEAGE-002).
